result.title: Embedding Prediction Helps Image Generation
result.summary: In diffusion transformers, a class label or a text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step. We ask whether predicted embeddings can serve as this condition instead. Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression (NEPA) trains a Transformer to predict the next continuous embedding in a sequence. In generation, the clean image follows the noisy image, so its embeddings are the next embeddings after the condition and the noisy image. We train a NEPA model to predict them all at once with Multi-Embedding Prediction, and in Embedding Conditioned Generation, a DiT generator is conditioned on these predictions, recomputed at every denoising step, so the conditioning signal adapts to the current noisy state. Experiments on class-conditional ImageNet $256\times256$ study the condition of the generator, the design of Multi-Embedding Prediction, and the scaling of both models. The NEPA model adds a second network to every sampling step; with it, and combined with REPA, our final model, NEPA-DiT-XL, reaches an FID of 1.32 using about a third of the training compute of REPA.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 NEPA：训练 Transformer 自回归预测序列中的下一个连续嵌入，并在扩散生成中把预测嵌入作为条件，在每个去噪步重算以适配当前噪声状态；在类别条件 ImageNet 256×256 上联合 REPA 达到 FID 1.32。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作关注的是生成条件而非视觉推理状态，但「预测下一嵌入并每步重算条件」的机制可能启发 LVR 中 latent 状态随计算动态更新的设计，可供核查其在推理状态生成与训练监督上的迁移线索。
